items.label: MODULAR FURNITURE SET
items.value: This versatile furniture set features a table, one double sofa, and two chairs to provide four seats that can be mixed & matched to your sitting space

items.label: DURABLE MATERIALS
items.value: All-weather wicker is handwoven over a steel frame for lasting durability, while weather-resistant cushions prevent fading and wear from the wind and rain

items.label: GLASS TABLE TOP
items.value: The wicker coffee table comes with a removable, tempered glass top to create a smooth, sturdy surface for food and drinks

items.label: MACHINE-WASHABLE COVERS
items.value: Removable cushion covers come out clean with warm soap and water to maintain a clean, plush appearance for years to come

items.label: GREAT FOR OUTDOOR SPACES
items.value: The perfect way to enhance your backyard, balcony, patio, and other outdoor sitting spaces; DOUBLE SOFA: 43"(L) x 26"(W) x 30"(H); Chair (each): 26"(L) x 23.5"(W) x 31"(H); COFFEE TABLE: 35"(L) x 18"(W) x 17"(H)
